snippet.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker - Story Trailer | Bandai Namco Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Story Trailer for The Blood of Dawnwalker, an upcoming third-person action adventure RPG developed by Rebel Wolves. Players will become human by day, and vampire by night to shape the story of the game through the deep 14th-century European setting. The Blood of Dawnwalker is launching in 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
